trait.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: The prowler has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in the forest. Creatures who attack a target that cannot see them have advantage on their attack roll.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the prowler moves at least 10 feet toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition Prone|PHB}. The prowler can use its bonus action to make another claw attack against this target.

trait.name: Ambuscade
entries: The prowler can take the {@action Dash} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The prowler makes two claw attacks and one bite attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + 4} slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d8 + 4} piercing damage. If the target is {@condition Prone|PHB}, it takes an additional {@damage 1d8} piercing damage.
